6752733722.name: Franzie: Read & Learn German
6752733722.description:
Ready to learn German in a way that’s actually fun and effective?

Franzie is a unique language learning app that combines a proven educational method with smart AI technology.

Our foundation is the science-backed method of extensive reading, inspired by Stephen Krashen's theory of comprehensible input. The principle is simple: you learn best by reading large amounts of enjoyable material at your level. It’s like having a German graded reader in your pocket, making your German practice engaging and effective. You absorb grammar and vocabulary naturally, without boring drills or complex rule memorization.
